what: Text is split into words and letters, and each letter turns on in random order over .15s (overall spread .3s) — Hero copy and section titles form up dot by dot like pixels. On exit they scatter away in the same manner. With flicker, on hover each letter turns off for .07s then back on .14s later for .07s (random start within 0~.32s), so menu text glitches

options.show: load (right on attach, default) · view (once when it enters the screen) · on (on from the start, no motion) · manual (via the element’s fxPixelChars.show() · hide())
options.dur: Time for one letter to light up (s), default .15
options.amount: Time to spread across the whole text (sec), default .3
options.flicker: If on, letters flicker on hover
options.fx:shown·fx:hidden: Event the element fires when fully on or fully off
